description: Say whether URL / Drive sources have drifted from what they point at. Name no source to check the whole notebook. RPC-backed (no browser). `stale: null` means the server did not say — not that the source is current.

source_name.description: Part of a source title (alternative to source_id).

name: check_source_freshness

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
